viewing_check: Plane: confirm box and plane match (GK12005 on both), any rust or use on the sole and blade, leaflet complete. Block plane: read model number and maker on the lever cap or body (a No.18/60 1/2/9 1/2 is worth more than a generic one). Drawknife: maker stamp on the blade (e.g. Stanley, Sorby, Witherby) and any pitting.
